subsection.title: Target User and Core Problem
subsection.description: - In one concise context, identify exactly one Primary Persona, the concrete problem they face, and the present consequence. - Mention the current workaround or evidence only when it materially clarifies the problem. - If several personas are possible, ask the user to choose the most important one. Do not combine them.

subsection.title: Value and Core Hypothesis
subsection.description: - State the value the Primary Persona should gain and why that matters to the team or organization. - State the single most important belief this PoC should test. - Keep it concise. Do not require a metric, customer promise, hypothesis inventory, or FAQ unless the user already has one. - Do not invent business claims or measures the user did not provide or approve.
